# pve-rclone-backup backup

List and inspect offsite backups.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`delete`](#backup-delete) | Mark an offsite backup for deletion (after rclone-delete-grace) |
| [`fetch`](#backup-fetch) | Download an offsite backup into a local backup storage |
| [`inspect`](#backup-inspect) | Show a backup's manifest summary |
| [`list`](#backup-list) | List offsite backups |
| [`notes`](#backup-notes) | Show or (with --set) change a backup's notes |
| [`protect`](#backup-protect) | Protect a backup from deletion and retention |
| [`undelete`](#backup-undelete) | Keep a backup marked for deletion |
| [`unprotect`](#backup-unprotect) | Remove a backup's protection |
| [`verify`](#backup-verify) | Verify an offsite backup |

## backup delete

Mark an offsite backup for deletion (after rclone-delete-grace).

```
pve-rclone-backup backup delete <volid>
```

## backup fetch

Download an offsite backup, verify it and place it in a local backup storage, where it appears
as a native backup that PVE can restore. It is protected by default so that the next local
prune does not remove it, and it is never uploaded again.

```
pve-rclone-backup backup fetch <volid> [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--no-protect` | do not protect the fetched backup |
| `--no-wait` | return once the job is queued |
| `--to-storage string` | local backup storage to place the archive in |

## backup inspect

Show a backup's manifest summary.

```
pve-rclone-backup backup inspect <volid>
```

## backup list

List offsite backups.

```
pve-rclone-backup backup list [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--state string` | states (comma separated, or 'all'; default complete,damaged) |
| `--storage string` | only this storage |
| `--type string` | only qemu or lxc guests |
| `--vmid int` | only this guest |

## backup notes

Show or (with --set) change a backup's notes.

```
pve-rclone-backup backup notes <volid> [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--set string` | new notes |

## backup protect

Protect a backup from deletion and retention.

```
pve-rclone-backup backup protect <volid>
```

## backup undelete

Keep a backup marked for deletion.

```
pve-rclone-backup backup undelete <volid>
```

## backup unprotect

Remove a backup's protection.

```
pve-rclone-backup backup unprotect <volid>
```

## backup verify

Verify an offsite backup.

Level 2 rechecks presence, sizes and provider checksums of the storage's backups without
downloading. Level 3 (default) downloads the archive, checks every digest and, when the tools are
installed, the archive's structure. Level 4 restores it into a scratch guest (--scratch-vmid) and
removes that guest again.

```
pve-rclone-backup backup verify <volid> [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--level int` | verification level: 2, 3 or 4 (default `3`) |
| `--no-wait` | return once the job is queued |
| `--scratch-storage string` | storage for the scratch guest's disks |
| `--scratch-vmid int` | unused VMID for the level 4 restore test |

Every command also accepts the [global options](index.md#global-options).
